FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(KUALA LUMPURKARAK HIGHWAY) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 4) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads (Private

Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Kuala LumpurKarak Highway) (Amendment) (No. 4)

Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2015.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(Kuala LumpurKarak Highway) Order 1994 [P. U. (A) 369/1994] is amended by

substituting for the First Schedule the following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[subparagraph 2(1)]

RATES OF TOLL FOR THE CONCESSION PERIOD FROM 15 OCTOBER 2015

UNTIL 28 JULY 2032

(1)

Classes of Vehicle

(2)

Toll Payable

(RM)

Gombak Toll Plaza Bentong Toll Plaza

1. Vehicle having two axles and three

or four wheels (excluding taxi and

bus)

6.00 3.50

2. Vehicle having two axles and five or

six wheels (excluding bus)

12.00 7.00

3. Vehicle having three axles or more

(excluding bus)

18.00 10.50

4. Taxi 3.00 1.80

5. Bus 5.00 3.00

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicles.".

Made 12 October 2015

[KKR/PUU.110-1/7/3; PN(PU2)426/LX]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Minister of Works
